DIAGNOSIS READY: Sleep Terrors (Night Terrors).

The patient's history of sudden frightened awakenings from deep sleep in an 8-year-old, combined with the absence of snoring or daytime sleepiness (ruling out obstructive sleep apnea) and normal polysomnography results, strongly points to Sleep Terrors.
